about: The global sender set: invented senders and what each is. Committed to a public repo, so nothing here may come from a real store: names, companies and addresses are invented on the example domains, and only public services (github.com, linkedin.com) keep their own. The person is alex@acme.example, so acme.example is their organisation. Kinds: human (a person), bot (a notifier, relay or no-reply address: nobody reads replies), list (a distribution list or group you're addressed through), brand (an organisation, newsletter or team inbox speaking as itself). `seen` is what Fuzz knows beyond the message: whether the org directory found them, and the other names this address has sent as. Scored by `fuzz eval senders` with no model, so the answer is the same every run.
